description_en: Query the summary report of agent metrics for a specified time range
description_zh: 查询坐席指标的某个时间范围汇总报表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-agent-summary-reports --instance-id b0eb2742-f37e-4c67-82d4-25c651c1c450 --skill-group-id fb654c6-17c6-4501-ba57-f5ddeb919814 --agent-ids 2769707711429472695 --start-time 2018-08-01_00:00:00 --end-time 2018-08-07_00:00:00 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --api-version 2017-07-05 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAgentSummaryReports

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the call center
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: List of agent IDs separated by commas (","). The agent ID is equivalent to the RAM Sub-account ID of the agent. A maximum of 50 agents is allowed. If this parameter is not specified, all agents are queried
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID列表(使用“,”隔开)，坐席ID等同于该座席的RAM子账户ID，最多50个坐席；不传查询全部
parameters.name: agent_ids

parameters.help_en: Start date, in the format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. Note that queries are currently supported only at the day dimension. For parameter settings, refer to the examples. Additionally, the specified time must not be earlier than six months ago
parameters.help_zh: 起始日期，格式yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss；需要注意目前仅支持按天维度的查询，参数设置请参考案例。同时时间设置不得早于6个月前的时间点
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: End date, in the format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. Note that queries are currently supported only at the day dimension. For parameter settings, refer to the examples
parameters.help_zh: 终止日期，格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss；需要注意目前仅支持按天维度的查询，参数设置请参考案例
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Page size. Default value is 10, and the maximum is 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认值为10，最大是100
parameters.name: page_size
